name: movie-streaming-app
description: YouTube-style movie streaming platform with admin dashboard

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
